text: Part 1 of the fix for job 20261024-140624-ewbs (which timed out as one job): in crates/athena-data/src/history.rs, give LandingCommit a required kind, a snake_case enum with job_landing, declared_intervention and records_only. A job_landing entry must carry its job and verification; the other two must not claim a job. Keep deny_unknown_fields. Update the validation and round-trip tests (each kind round-trips; an unknown kind, a missing kind, an unknown field, and a job_landing entry without job or verification are rejected), and update the one place in crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs that builds a LandingCommit so it sets job_landing, leaving pr_commits for part 2. Run only the athena-data and athena-core tests you need while working.
